unit_rules.name: Rites of Battle
unit_rules.text: Once per Battle Round, you may target a friendly +Captain+ model (and its attached unit) with a Strategem, even if that Strategem has already been used that Battle Round. The Strategem costs 1 CP less.

unit_rules.name: Finest Hour
unit_rules.text: This ability may be activated once per battle. Until the end of the phase, this model's melee weapons have +3 Attacks and +[Devastating Wounds]+.
